official_identity_sources.observation: The current RODA Bernardo collection page confirms the manufacturer, family, Rodolfo Dordoni design, white Simplon-stone base and painted stainless-steel structure. It routes collection 2D and 3D drawings to the authenticated reserved area. The current public page lists 353 and 354 rather than the discontinued 367, so it is family and access-boundary evidence only.

RODA Catalogue 2024 explicitly labels BERNARDO 367, shows the square-top pedestal table, and specifies W 50 x D 50 x H 67 cm with a 30 cm diameter by 4 cm stone base. The extract is identity and dimensional evidence, not native Plan/Front/Side CAD geometry.

project_ifc_identity_evidence.note: The exact type description, Bernardo-named stone and milk-metal styles, table topology and exact catalogue envelope identify the model. These IFC labels are project-model evidence, not a purchase order or manufacturer shop drawing.

official_product_cad.reason: RODA routes Bernardo collection 2D and 3D downloads to its authenticated reserved area. No manufacturer account was created and no third-party CAD was substituted.
